title: Oracle: OD-16 rules BL-17 — the regression title is the declared reconstruction
body:
Oracle ruling on the logged evidence `BL-17` (with `BL-9`), dispatched by the unattended delivery driver on base `run/web`.

**OD-16** — `R1003`'s regression title is **the declared reconstruction**, asserted by canonical and never by string. This ratifies the default the steward proceeded on in `docs/plans/oracle/itx-chipset-variant.md`, so that plan stands as written.

- No requirement is added and none superseded: the ruling settles what the fixture *is* and how it may be asserted, not what the system must do.
- Same shape as `OD-15` before it: the steward met an under-specified fixture, judged it LOW, proceeded on a recorded default, and filed. The oracle reviewed on the next cycle and made the record say which set is authoritative.
- The "asserted by canonical, never by string" half is the part worth reading: it keeps the test from pinning a reconstructed title's exact wording, so the fixture can be replaced with the real measurement later without rewriting the assertion.

Handoff: `docs/oracle/handoff-2026-08-20-4.md`.

Opened by the server-side `open-pr` workflow at the driver's request (ESC-50).
